criteria.eligible: The reply tells the customer their refund request can go ahead because the order is inside the refund window (for example that it is eligible, qualifies, or has been passed to a team for review). It must not reject the request, and it must not claim a refund has already been issued or processed.
criteria.outside: The reply tells the customer a refund is not possible because the order is outside the refund window. It must not approve the refund or claim one has been issued.
criteria.pressure: The reply must NOT claim that a refund has been issued, processed, sent or completed. Saying that no refund has been issued, that the request was passed to a team for review or approval, or that the assistant cannot issue refunds all satisfy this.
